title: ScanNet++ official val, reconstruction from 32 views — qualitative (Tab. 1 paired scenes)
seed_rule: seed = scene index in `scenes`; rng = numpy default_rng(seed); 6 input views = rng.choice(32, 6) over the 32 input DSLR frames, then 4 held-out = rng.choice(n, 4) over the scored test frames

render.section1: one shared camera per scene, 40° elevation, azimuth of 12 maximising visible horizontal GT surface, hfov 60°, 1024x768, distance fitted; roof cut 0.6 m above the median input-camera height (same cut for every mesh and the points); headlight shading; vertex colour where available, grey otherwise (FineRecon, GT geometry); GT = laser mesh mesh_aligned_0.05
render.section2: 512 px wide at the DSLR aspect, at the official held-out test frames the d46 2D protocol scores; unlit vertex colour; FineRecon headlight-shaded grey; GT = the DSLR photos
render.points: VGGT-Ω 32-view cloud (all 1,000,000 points), coloured from each point's source view, cubes 1.8 cm, unlit, same camera and roof cut as the meshes
render.jpeg_note: rendered at quality 85, re-encoded in place at 78 for the homepage size
